title: Lemon Kingdom
description: Realistic lemon farming with natural growth cycles. Harvest via Right-Click. Beta version: expect bugs and frequent updates. This is my first mod, focused on logical mechanics. Incomplete, but more content is coming soon! 🍋
body:
🍋 LemonKingdom
Lemon Kingdom is a project created by a developer who values realism and logical processes. Instead of instant magic, this mod introduces a gradual, natural growth system for lemon trees, making the world feel a bit more alive and grounded.

🌿 Current Features:
Natural Growth Cycle: Lemon leaves progress through stages—from empty branches to blooming flowers, and finally to ripe fruit.

Realistic Mechanics: Growth is based on random game ticks, just like vanilla crops.

Non-Destructive Harvest: Collect lemons using Right-Click without breaking the leaves.

Early Processing: Includes basic blocks like the Fermentator and Lemon Crates for initial resource management.

⚠️ Work in Progress (Beta):
Please note that this is my first mod and it is currently an incomplete version.

Bugs: You might encounter some bugs or technical glitches. I am working on fixing them as I learn more.

Updates: Frequent updates are planned to expand the mechanics and add new content.

Feedback: Since the mod is in early development, your reports and suggestions are very helpful!
